the use of alternate and simultaneous wire tensioning is not a clinically significant issue.

the tensioning sequence in a single-ring circular fixator does not affect the stiffness or stability of a construct, and therefore, the sequence of tensioning the wires is of no importance.

the simultaneous application of tension to all wires in a single ring fixator (SRF) construct results in a more stable construct.
